_comment: Copy to paper/delivery.json and fill in. delivery.json is git-ignored and must stay that way - a bot token lets anyone post as the bot, and an app password is a password. This repository is public.

telegram._setup: Message @BotFather -> /newbot -> copy the token here. Then send your new bot any message (a bot cannot open the conversation), and run: .venv/Scripts/python.exe backtest/deliver.py --chat-id

email._setup: Gmail needs an APP PASSWORD (myaccount.google.com/apppasswords), not your account password, and 2FA must be on for app passwords to exist. Port 587 uses STARTTLS, 465 uses SSL.
